name: Cascade Failure — Disk Full, Service Crashed, 502 Errors
description: Three simultaneous production failures: disk at ~95% from a crash-loop log flood, api.service stopped (deployment bug — missing /etc/api/config.yaml), and nginx returning 502. The disk must be freed first to unblock logging; then /etc/api/config.yaml created so api.service can start; nginx recovers automatically once the API is healthy. Backup config available at /opt/api/config-backup/config.yaml.
